verdict.rationale: No first-party doc in the pack claims GGUF support. Community reports suggest it indirectly: one says Cactus vendored llama.cpp, and another says the demo app offered GGUF download links for Jan Nano and SmolLM3, but the app crashed as soon as those models were selected. The current GitHub docs describe converting HuggingFace models with `cactus convert`, which points to a separate converted format rather than native GGUF loading. missing for 10: first-party documentation of GGUF loading, evidence that GGUF models actually run successfully, details on which GGUF quantizations are supported.
